name: tracking-one
description: Track ocean containers, bills of lading, bookings and air waybills with live data from the carrier.

interface.longDescription:
Tracking One brings shipment tracking into ChatGPT. Ask about a container number, a bill of lading, a booking number or an air waybill in plain words, and get live data from the carrier: current status, origin and destination, every milestone with its date and place, vessels and voyages or flights, and the route on a map.

What you can ask:
- "Where is container MSCU1234567?"
- "Track bill of lading MAEU123456789 and tell me the ETA at Rotterdam"
- "What is the status of air waybill 176-12345675?"
- "Check these five containers and tell me which ones are delayed"
- "Which carriers can you track by booking number?"

Ocean tracking covers the major container lines and works by container, bill of lading or booking number. Air cargo tracking works by the 11-digit air waybill number. Several numbers can be tracked in one message. A number that is new to the system can take a few minutes while the carrier is queried, and you are told when to ask again.

All tools are read-only. Nothing is booked, changed or sent on your behalf.

A Tracking One account is required. You sign in once and choose which products ChatGPT may use, with an optional monthly limit.

defaultPrompt: Track my container by its number
Check the status of an air waybill
Which ocean carriers can you track by booking number?

positive.expected_behavior: Shows the shipment card with status, route, events with dates and places, and vessels.

positive.prompt: Track bill of lading ZIMUIAH992896 and tell me the ETA at the port of discharge
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the shipment and names the estimated arrival at the port of discharge.

positive.prompt: What is the status of air waybill 612-12952995?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the air shipment card with status, flights and events.

positive.prompt: Can you track Maersk by booking number?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Maersk in the carrier list and says which number types it supports.

positive.prompt: How many shipments can I still track?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the remaining tracking quota of the account per product.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Rotterdam today?
What documents do I need to import electronics from China into Germany, and what import duty applies?
Write a polite email to my freight forwarder asking why my shipment is delayed and when it will arrive.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads shipment tracking data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: ocean tracking by container, bill of lading or booking number, air cargo tracking by air waybill, carrier lists and account usage.
